purpose: Portable input template for binding one project to the Governance 2.1rc kernel without importing another project's context.

authority_corpus_binding.root_rule: Every configured authority or evidence-library root is repository-relative or resolves beneath the admitted authority_root after canonical normalization. Absolute host-specific storage is forbidden unless the project explicitly admits it as nonportable context.
authority_corpus_binding.tree_rule: The portable authority-corpus tree may be extended with typed project nodes, but required page identities, ownership, provenance, freshness, append-only logs, pseudocode context, sealed-history, and deterministic indexing cannot be removed.
authority_corpus_binding.numbering_rule: Generated standard authority uses immutable half-open numeric blocks: 000 Bootstrap, 0001..0099 governance, 0100..0199 shared project context, then one 100-number block per feature beginning at 0200. Existing allocations are preserved; overflow uses linked extensions.
authority_corpus_binding.index_rule: The authority index path is unique and generated from exact page bytes and metadata; it is not hand-maintained authority.
authority_corpus_binding.bootstrap_rule: An empty project may instantiate the complete initial tree and adjacent active/historical evidence-library layout from this context plus the portable registry without importing another project's pages or facts.

concrete_instance_binding.rule: A project-specific registry MUST contain one portable_template_instance whose groups and fields conform exactly to required. Project-specific compatibility fields may coexist outside that instance but cannot substitute for it.
concrete_instance_binding.digest_rule: project_identity.exact_context_digest is lowercase SHA-256 of the UTF-8 compact canonical JSON for portable_template_instance after omitting exact_context_digest itself. Canonical JSON recursively orders object keys by unsigned UTF-8 byte order, preserves array order, and contains no insignificant whitespace.
concrete_instance_binding.repository_rule: repositories is a nonempty array of typed records. Every repository_id is unique; every remote, default_branch, ownership value, and protected_paths member is a nonempty string.
concrete_instance_binding.capability_rule: enabled_baseline_capability_ids contains every exact portable baseline capability ID once. typed_project_capability_extensions is an array whose members conform to extension_schema.
concrete_instance_binding.interval_rule: Every operational interval is a positive finite integer number of minutes.
concrete_instance_binding.extension_rule: Additional project fields are permitted only outside portable_template_instance or through typed_project_capability_extensions; they cannot shadow or weaken a required portable field.

elicitation_binding.rule: Project extensions may add domain-specific questions and safe defaults but cannot remove the portable project-goal, design-system, or feature drill-me foundations.
elicitation_binding.human_question_boundary: Ask the human only when exact admitted authority and mechanical source/runtime inspection cannot safely resolve a material intent, preference, conflict, or owner-only decision.
elicitation_binding.completion: Reasonable sufficiency, not exhaustive certainty, permits compilation. Remaining non-route-changing gaps are explicit deferred context.

extension_schema.rule: Extensions add project capability context only and cannot override portable roles, writer exclusivity, audit independence, Runtime execution-only authority, owner-only classes, or kernel authority/failure/proof/handoff law.

reject: missing exact authority or project-context identity
copied identity, path, role, credential, provider, domain, or protected surface from another project
missing, unresolved, escaping, overlapping, or host-specific authority-corpus root without explicit nonportable admission
authority page or index without one owner, provenance, freshness, and supersession law
context elicitation that asks for discoverable facts, invents answers, or requires exhaustive certainty
context blocker without affected outcome, unaffected work, responsible owner, safe default, and exact resume condition
missing progress, supervisor, or lease-recovery interval
capability extension without one owner and handoff
project context that weakens or overrides the portable kernel
validation.result: One self-contained project-context registry and compact task-specific context capsules.
